Name: Jahath, Son of Shimei
Summary: Son of Shimei, chief among the sons of Shimei.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:10: Son of Shimei, chief among the sons of Shimei.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jahath stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
